QA Data Generator
GUI + CLI
Good data. Bad data.
And the right answer.
A test data generator for forms, APIs and file imports. It
makes whole datasets, breaks them on purpose, and tells
your tests what your app should do with each value.
Recipes
 - describe your own dataset in YAML, get thousands
of rows in CSV or JSON
Good data
 - SSN, VIN, ISBN, IMEI, PESEL and 7 more
Bad data
 - 18 ways to break a value
The right answer
 - accept or reject, in a file your CI reads
Free, GPL-3.0  ·  works offline  ·  Windows, macOS, Linux
